subject: Mutual Action Plan: Hosting path, eval milestones, and close windows
messages:
From: Jordan Lowe <jordan.lowe@novahealth.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + hosting options (hosted/dedicated/private)

Chloe —

Thanks for the demo this week. Per our discussion, procurement asked me to put together a short MAP so we can align on evaluation milestones and a target close window. High-level asks from my side:

- Decision needed on hosting mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated pool vs Private/VPC) — this will drive legal and infra lead times.
- Target pilot: PII-free search assistant for clinical docs (low token volumes but low latency requirement).
- Desired timeline: pilot start in early July, production by end of Q3 if possible.

I've attached a draft MAP (NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx) with suggested milestones. Can you confirm Redwood's recommended path given our use case and whether SOC2 evidence and a VPC/private option are feasible within our timeline?

Jordan
Head of Product, NovaHealth
Attachment: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lowe <jordan.lowe@novahealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + hosting options (hosted/dedicated/private)

Jordan —

Thanks for the draft MAP and the clear timeline. Quick summary from our side:

- Recommended path for NovaHealth pilot: Dedicated capacity in us-east-1. Rationale: predictable throughput for latency-sensitive queries and straightforward isolation without full private control plane work.
- Hosted API would be fastest to start (days) but might introduce higher variance in tail latency for peak loads.
- Private (VPC/on-prem) is possible but introduces procurement and network setup that typically adds 6–10 weeks.

I've attached a short evaluation plan and proposed milestone dates. Key asks from your side: confirmation of pilot scope (tokens/day), sample prompt set for our quality checks, and PO/procurement contact for SOW routing.

Proposed milestones (high level):
- 2026-06-07: Finalize MAP and sign SOW (DocuSign link to follow).
- 2026-06-14 to 06-25: Integration + test harness (staging).
- 2026-07-05: Pilot go-live (dedicated in us-east-1).
- 2026-09-30: Production cutover decision / expansion.

Attaching: Redwood_eval_plan_Nova_v1.pdf and Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf

I'll loop in Priyom and Rishi for procurement and SOC2 specifics; Marissa will help with rollout playbook and runbooks.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_eval_plan_Nova_v1.pdf (PDF stub)

From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan + hosting options — internal notes

Forwarding NovaHealth MAP thread. Notes / internal checklist before we finalize the SOW:

- Latency requirements: Jordan flagged "low latency" for clinical search; treat 95th percentile < 120ms as target. We should double-check model choice and batching policy to meet that on dedicated.
- Data classification: Pilot PII-free, but potential production includes PHI — escalate private/VPC feasibility and timeline if they plan PHI later.
- SOC2 evidence: Rishi please surface the specific evidence pack we can share and typical lead times for any customer-specific controls.
- Procurement: Priyom to draft SOW that supports a 30-day pilot term + option to convert to annual dedicated commit. Include optional add-on for Private deployment fees.
- Region: They prefer us-east-1. Ensure capacity planning for dedicated pools in that region; Marissa, are there spare nodes in the June window?

Also, I'm proposing we offer a "hybrid ramp" option: start with Hosted for immediate functional checks (2–3 days) then migrate to Dedicated for pilot SLA. This reduces initial integration risk while keeping the procurement path straightforward. Thoughts?

-- Chloe

Subject: RE: Mutual action plan + hosting options (updated MAP and SOW draft)

Jordan / procurement team —

Thanks for the clear timeline. Attached is an updated MAP (NovaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW that reflects:

- Pilot: Dedicated capacity in us-east-1 for the July pilot (30-day pilot term).
- Pricing: month-to-month pilot at committed rate with credit toward annual reserved commitment if you convert within 45 days.
- Security: Included Redwood SOC2 evidence pack excerpt; full package available after NDA (we can share the standard PDF now).
- Private option: quoted as a separate line item; estimated 6–9 week network/onboarding timeline once you sign for Private.

Action items for procurement to accept pilot SOW:
1) Confirm PO/POC and billing contact.
2) Sign the DocuSign SOW (link below).
3) Provide sample prompt set and any non-production dataset for our quality checks.

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Redwood-NH-SOW (stub link)

If this looks good I can convert the draft to a formal SOW and push DocuSign.

- Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: NovaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Draft_SOW_Nova_v1.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Jordan Lowe <jordan.lowe@novahealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@novahealth.com>, Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + hosting options (updated MAP and SOW draft)

Thanks — this all looks reasonable. A few quick confirmations from NovaHealth: 

- We want to proceed with Dedicated capacity in us-east-1 for the pilot. That meets our latency needs and procurement prefers a dedicated billing line for the pilot.
- Procurement: I'll route the DocuSign to our finance team today; PO should be generated by Friday.
- Security: please share the SOC2 excerpt and the standard security pack; we'll loop our security reviewers.

Next steps on our side: expect PO and signed SOW this week. For the pilot, we'll provide a non-production dataset (anonymized) and a 50–100 prompt list by 2026-06-07.

Appreciate the hybrid-start suggestion; we may take you up on a same-day hosted smoke test before the dedicated pool is provisioned.

Jordan
Head of Product, NovaHealth
